advisor_identified: Professor of History and holder of the Chair in Slovak History and Culture at the University of Ottawa, appointed in 1992.

doctorate.title: Immigration and Urbanization: The Slovak Experience, 1870-1918

evidence.says: His CV, page 1, lists a Ph.D. in History from the University of Minnesota in 1974 and his University of Ottawa professorship and chair appointment from 1992.

The library catalogue attributes Immigration and urbanization: the Slovak experience, 1870-1918 to Marian Mark Stolarik and describes it as a photocopy of his Ph.D. thesis, University of Minnesota, 1974.

The society identifies Stolarik as University of Ottawa professor and chairholder emeritus and states that Minnesota awarded his Ph.D. in 1974 for Immigration and Urbanization: The Slovak Experience, 1870-1918.

notes: The linked AHA record matches the advisor’s doctoral institution, year and dissertation title; its semicolon after Urbanization is a punctuation variation.
